## 2. Sports Editorial & Real-Time Data (Root Vertical)
Laku Media Concept operates an independent sports desk focusing on African and international football.
- **Domestic Focus**: Nigeria Premier Football League (NPFL), featuring 20 top clubs including:
  - Remo Stars FC (Ikenne)
  - Enyimba International FC (Aba)
  - Rangers International FC (Enugu)
  - Rivers United FC (Port Harcourt)
  - Kano Pillars FC (Kano)
  - Shooting Stars SC / 3SC (Ibadan)
  - Bendel Insurance FC (Benin City)
  - Ikorodu City FC (Lagos)
  - Plateau United FC (Jos)
  - Katsina United FC (Katsina)
  - Abia Warriors FC (Umuahia)
  - Bayelsa United FC (Yenagoa)
  - Kwara United FC (Ilorin)
  - Nasarawa United FC (Lafia)
  - Niger Tornadoes FC (Minna)
  - El-Kanemi Warriors (Maiduguri)
- **Super Eagles & Global Diaspora Watch**:
  - Real-time performance tracking of Nigerian international footballers across European leagues, the Middle East, and the Americas.
  - Granular season stats covering League matches, Continental cups (UEFA Champions League, Europa League), and international appearances.
  - Profiles for stars including Victor Osimhen, Ademola Lookman, Victor Boniface, Alex Iwobi, Samuel Chukwueze, Calvin Bassey, Wilfred Ndidi, and Stanley Nwabali.
- **Covered International Leagues**:

  - UEFA Champions League (UCL)

## 3. Creative Multimedia & Outside Broadcast (OB) Services (/multimedia)
Laku Media Concept provides full-stack broadcast engineering and media production:
- **OB Satellite Uplink & Remote Broadcast**: Mobile multi-camera live broadcast vans equipped for high-definition and 4K satellite transmission, live event streaming, sports coverage, and religious conventions.
- **Cinematic Film & Television Production**: Full production pipeline from scriptwriting, location scouting, set design, multi-camera cinematography, to theatrical color grading.
- **Music Video Production**: High-concept visual storytelling, 8K RED and ARRI camera rigs, and creative choreography capture.
- **Theatrical Sound Engineering**: 5.1/7.1 surround sound mastering, location audio recording, and Foley sound design.
- **Drone Cinematography**: Certified aerial drone operators equipped with high-resolution cinema drones for landscape, event, and cinematic sequence capture.
- **Studio Space & Production Gear Rental**: Acoustically treated soundstages, lighting rigs, audio gear, and camera support in Lagos.
